claims.text: Whether the rider was at the pin is not a condition of this charge and must not be turned into one. POL-NS-06 makes a waiting-period shortfall refundable 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and none of POL-NS-01's four limbs reads rider position at all; rider presence enters the policy only in POL-NS-04(c), where it can exonerate a rider who messaged and never condemn one who did not. The rider track that the platform records roughly 519 m from the pin is therefore put out of account, and no adverse inference about the rider's whereabouts may be drawn from it.

The driver cannot stretch his hold past the single run his trace records. The only traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-09101-01, is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and POL-NS-06(i) is expressly unavailable on a MISSING or unpopulated traffic_advisory: none of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT can be invoked to sum separate in-geofence intervals, and the driver cannot point to a second qualifying interval to add to the first. Chargeability of the SGD 4.00 fee must stand or fall on the one measured run alone.

Even taken at its highest, the driver's case clears the bar by twenty seconds. His qualifying run is 320 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, and it is measured from the first in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 - twenty seconds before the driver's own 'arrived' event at 08:10:20, the event POL-NS-01(a) requires - so the hold that the record can tie to his own arrival marker is exactly at the threshold. On the ten-second sampling the trace actually carries, a margin of this width should be required to be established on admissible in-radius fixes rather than assumed, and any doubt on this limb is a doubt that defeats POL-NS-01(c).

No adverse finding may be built on the rider's lifetime no-show counter. POL-NS-09(d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0 for this rider, and POL-GEN-01 names only that trailing-30-day field as citable for the test while warning in terms that the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (1 here) is a near-synonym that may not be substituted for it. The lifetime figure is context only and cannot be used to characterise this rider as an abuser.

If the effective in-geofence dwell is found to fall short of the 300-second minimum, or the arrival marker is found not to start the clock, the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown is not chargeable under POL-NS-06, the full amount is refunded to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable on this record.

If, on the twenty-second margin and the discrepancy between the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 and the 'arrived' event at 08:10:20, the Judge's confidence in the driver's arrival and dwell falls below the 0.70 platform floor, POL-NS-09(a) requires the case to be escalated to a human reviewer. An escalated fee is held rather than collected, so on that outcome the rider would not be carrying the disputed charge while the review is pending.

claims.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-09101 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00. (b) EV-GPS-09101 places the driver inside the pickup geofence before that event: the trace's first fix is at 08:10:00 and every fix sits a mean 24.01 m from the pin, well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. (c) The driver held position for a continuous 320 seconds, above the 300 second STANDARD minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) directs rather than from the arrival tap. (d) EV-TRIP-09101 records no boarding event and a driver termination with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 08:15:20, after the required dwell had elapsed. The cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

POL-NS-02's proximity test is met on the code-computed facts, not on assertion. EV-GPS-09101 carries 33 driver fixes for which min_distance_m, mean_distance_m and max_distance_m are all 24.01 m from the pickup pin, comfortably inside the 50 m arrival radius the fee_schedule fixes for the STANDARD zone class, and all 33 are counted as qualifying fixes after the 25 m accuracy filter. The trace is clean: coverage_pct 100, max_gap_sec 0.0 and no gaps. The driver was physically at the pickup point.

POL-NS-05 does not bite, so the arrival marker is not false. At the arrival timestamp the driver was 24.01 m from the pin, not more than 300 m, and the only distinct speed anywhere in the trace is 0.0 kph, so he was not travelling at or above 15 kph. Neither independent trigger of POL-NS-05 operates, and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

POL-NS-06 does not engage, and no shortfall exists to excuse. The effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 320 seconds against a 300 second STANDARD minimum, a surplus of 20 seconds on the derived shortfall figure. Because the minimum was met without accumulation, limb (i) is never reached. Consistently with that, the driver does not rely on the traffic advisory limb: EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and it is immaterial here precisely because no accumulation is claimed.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because two of its three limbs fail. Limb (a): not one message in EV-CHAT-09101 was sent by the rider. All three messages are the SYSTEM arrival notice at 08:10:21 and two DRIVER messages - 'I am at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310' at 08:10:35 and 'Still waiting at the same pickup point' at 08:14:10. There is no locating or coordinating message from the rider to be left unanswered. Limb (c): the rider's track in EV-GPS-09101 holds 15 fixes of which 0 qualify (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), at a mean 519.37 m from the pin - more than five times the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider was not at the pickup point.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged either. Its wrong-entrance doctrine reaches only a driver stationary OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; this driver was inside the 50 m radius, so the clause has no purchase. Its pin-ambiguity limb is likewise unavailable: limb (ii) requires trip_record.registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and EV-TRIP-09101 records 1 for this pickup. The rider's 'I was downstairs' account is in any event contradicted by the rider's own device, which sat 519.37 m from the pin for the whole waiting window.

The charge is properly itemised and needs no correction. EV-FARE-09101 records a cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, charged at 08:15:22 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises and the itemised amount stands.

POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to compensation of SGD 3.20, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee itemised in EV-FARE-09101, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip and compensation is therefore not withheld: EV-DPROF-09101 shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against a threshold of 4, and the clause requires BOTH limbs, absolute count and rate, so the second limb is never reached. Only the two fields POL-NS-07 names - no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d - are used for that check, as POL-GEN-01 requires. Under POL-GEN-03 the outcome the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.20, while the rider's charge stands unchanged.

No escalation trigger is open on this record. The four POL-NS-01 limbs are carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so the confidence floor under POL-GEN-02(2) is not breached and POL-NS-09(a) is not reached. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence: the trip record's 5.0 minute wait and the trace's 320 second dwell agree rather than conflict. Both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not met. The case is decidable now.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your account that you were downstairs does not change the outcome, and your device's recorded position is not held against you. Chargeability turns only on the four conditions in POL-NS-01, none of which reads rider position — rider presence enters the policy only in POL-NS-04(c), where it can exonerate a rider who messaged and never condemn one who did not. On this record all four conditions hold. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-09101) contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09101) places the driver 24.01 m from the pin — inside the 50 m STANDARD radius fixed by the fee schedule — from 08:10:00, before that event, on 33 fixes that all pass the 25 m accuracy filter, across a 100%-coverage trace with no gaps. (c) He held position from 08:10:00 to 08:15:20: a continuous dwell of 320 seconds, measured as limb (c) directs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, and 20 seconds above the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. Your point that a 20-second margin is thin is answered by the arithmetic rather than by caution: the margin is not assumed, it is computed from 33 admissible in-radius fixes at a 10-second cadence with zero gaps, and the derived figures give the same 320 seconds. POL-NS-06 therefore finds no waiting-period shortfall and requires no refund, and the driver's own claim to a shorter, marginal hold is contradicted by his trace. POL-NS-05 does not disturb the clock: at the arrival marker the driver was 24.01 m from the pin, well under the 300 m trigger, and the only speed in the trace is 0.0 kph, under the 15 kph trigger, so there is no false-arrival recomputation. POL-NS-03 is not engaged because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and its pin-ambiguity limb requires two or more registered pickup points where the trip record shows one. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09101-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) leaves the cumulative-dwell limb of POL-NS-06 unavailable, but nothing relies on it, because the single measured run already clears the minimum; its absence changes nothing. To the driver: POL-NS-07 compensates you at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown — SGD 3.20 — with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and the clause requires both the absolute-count and the rate limb, so the check is not reached and no escalation packet is produced. The ruling is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd: SGD 3.20 is the money this ruling moves, not a refund to the rider. The rider's SGD 4.00 charge stands unchanged, exactly as itemised (STANDARD zone-class fee SGD 4.00 and RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee SGD 4.00, the greater of which is SGD 4.00, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d)). On escalation and profile matters: no POL-NS-09 trigger is open. Every deciding artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor; the trip record's five-minute wait and the trace's 320-second dwell agree rather than conflict, so limb (b) is not reached; both same-pair dispute counters are 0, so limb (c) is not reached; and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1, which is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not read by limb (d). Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, the fee stands and the driver is paid.
